name: biomed-workbench
description: Results-first biomedical research from study design and analysis to interpretation, figures, and publication.

interface.shortDescription: From biomedical question to reviewed research output.
interface.longDescription: One research entry for study design, evidence, bulk, single-cell, spatial, molecular, imaging, clinical, and experimental analysis, followed by biological interpretation, scientific figures, writing, and reproducible delivery.
defaultPrompt: Use biomed-workbench for donor-aware single-cell analysis and target-journal result writing.
Use biomed-workbench to design a bulk sequencing study, separating assay, target, controls, and normalization.
Use biomed-workbench to search evidence, run relevant analysis, and draft a publication-grade output.
